scripts.build: npm run build -w @vulnfuse/core && npm run build -w vulnfuse && npm run build -w @vulnfuse/web && npm run build -w @vulnfuse/action
scripts.test: node --test scripts/write-release-checksums.test.mjs scripts/release-documentation.test.mjs && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @vulnfuse/core && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.verify: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build && npm run check:repo
scripts.demo:cli: node packages/cli/dist/index.js merge packages/core/test/fixtures/trivy.json packages/core/test/fixtures/grype.json --format markdown
